result.brief: 提出 Flash Primitive Decoding，用轻量 drafter 一次前向联合预测视觉基元坐标，加速视觉规划并提升机器人轨迹预测精度与下游世界动作模型成功率。
result.reason: Visual planning via joint primitive decoding in VLM for robot/autonomous driving; world action model conditioned on plans. Main contribution is decoding/planning efficiency, not representation learning.
